title: Guest Surcharges Standing to Be Settled by the Employee
content:
A guest meal is charged to payroll net of the guest surcharge printed against the plan, so that surcharge stands to be settled by the employee rather than recovered from their pay. Where guests have been brought to the counter on an Employee Meal Account, an amount for those surcharges is carried into the paydown. The single guest relief for this purpose is $1.50.

**Clause.** Where the plan allows guest meals and two or more guest meals have been rung on the account in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the amount added for guest meals is the guest surcharge printed against the plan counted once for each of them, rounded to two decimal places at that step. Where the plan allows guest meals and exactly one guest meal has been rung on the account in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked, the amount added is that printed guest surcharge less the single guest relief, never read as less than nothing. Where neither holds, nothing is added for guest meals.

## The plan figures this reads

| Meal plan | Guest meals allowed | Guest surcharge printed against the plan |
|---|---|---|
| Pay-As-You-Go Badge Account | no | $0.00 |
| Prepaid Declining Balance Account | yes | $4.50 |
| Payroll Deduction Meal Account | yes | $4.50 |
| Subsidized Daily Allowance Account | yes | $5.25 |
| Full Subsidy Employee Meal Account | no | $0.00 |
| Executive Dining Charge Account | yes | $12.00 |

## The bands

| Plan allows guest meals | Guest meals rung in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked | Added for guest meals |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | The printed guest surcharge, once for each of them |
| Yes | Exactly 1 | The printed guest surcharge less $1.50, and never below nothing |
| Yes | None | Nothing |
| No | Any | Nothing |

*Hypothetical illustration.* On a plan printing a $4.50 guest surcharge, 3 guest meals rung in the three calendar months running back from the day the account is worked carry $13.50 into the paydown, and a single guest meal carries $4.50 less $1.50, or $3.00. On a plan printing a $1.00 guest surcharge, a single guest meal would carry nothing, since $1.00 less $1.50 is never read as less than nothing.
